title: busbar.conformance.verdict/1
description: One suite's arm-or-red fact, as its rig judged it. `cargo xtask conformance record` writes one `<suite>.json` here per suite it ran, stamped with the checkout's HEAD, and reconciles them into the manifest (the reconcile is `cargo xtask gate conformance-sync --write`). Every verdict is held to this schema before it is read, and a verdict whose `suite` is not the id it is filed under is refused. A registered suite with no verdict file is not-run, never green. Rules: armed==false requires status "not-run", so status "pass" requires armed==true; `commit` is the sha the SUBJECT was built from, which is what makes staleness detectable.

suite.description: Stable suite id, matching the registry and the file's own name.

commit.description: The sha the subject was built from.

cert_id.description: certified tier only: the issued cert id.

issuer.description: certified tier only: the body that issued it.

expires.description: certified tier only: cert validity end.
